observations: All six panels inspected. Four small flanged rail wheels, rear low cabin, forward cylindrical tooth drum on a horizontal axle, central hopper and lamps are coherent.
Working drum touches a marked mine face; both rails lie on supported ground in a timber-braced tunnel with generous visible roof space. This is illustrative clearance, not measured native evidence.
Front and rear are distinct: tool and work lamps face front, while the rear shows a service hatch and red lamps.
